enterpriseAdmin.title: Enterprise admin console
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDesc: Enter your local account password to unlock enterprise administration.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDescAuto: We will try your local password first, then your directory (LDAP) password.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDescLdap: Enter the directory (LDAP) password for the identity already bound to your account.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDescNoPassword: No password-based verification is available. Ask an administrator to set a local password or bind LDAP.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDescLdapLockedNotBound: LDAP verification requires linking your account to a directory identity first (same as LDAP sign-in rules). Choose Local password for now. After an admin binds LDAP under Users & members, Directory (LDAP) will work here.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDescLdapLockedNotConfigured: LDAP is not enabled or is missing required settings (server URL, base DN). Configure it under Auth & email, or use Local password.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateLdapNeedsBindingToast: This account does not have a linked LDAP identity. Ask an admin to bind LDAP under Users & members, or use local password for now.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateLdapNotConfiguredToast: LDAP is not enabled or not fully configured. Set it up under Auth & Email before using directory verification.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateNeedsLocalPasswordOrBindLdap: Cannot verify with directory yet: set a local admin password, or ask an admin to bind LDAP to this account first.
enterpriseAdmin.oauthHint: Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom verification will start here once OAuth elevation is wired up.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateDescOAuthPick: Choose a method above. OAuth sign-in will be available after integration.
enterpriseAdmin.oauthNotImplemented: This method is not available yet. Use a password method instead.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateHint: Choose one verification method to unlock enterprise management and system settings.
enterpriseAdmin.profileOnlyHint: You are signed in as a standard member and can only view your own account.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateIncorrectPassword: Incorrect password. Enter the password for your current WebUI login account. If you sign in with LDAP, choose "LDAP" as the verification method.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateRateLimited: Too many verification attempts in a short window. Wait about a minute or avoid double-clicking Confirm.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateGatewayTimeout: Gateway or proxy timed out (often HTTP 504/502). If you use Nginx/Tailscale, increase upstream timeouts or hit the WebUI port directly; the server may also be overloaded—retry later.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateServerError: Internal server error (HTTP 500)—usually not a wrong password. Check the 1ONE terminal/logs for the line after [AuthRoute] enterprise-elevate error and retry.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateFailedUnknown: Verification was rejected. If you submitted several times, wait and retry. If the password is correct, check the Network tab for POST /api/auth/enterprise-elevate status and response body.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateCsrf: Security check failed. Refresh the page, sign in again, and retry.
enterpriseAdmin.elevateNotEligible: This account is not eligible for enterprise admin verification.
enterpriseAdmin.elevationLoadFailed: Could not load enterprise verification state. Please try again.
enterpriseAdmin.elevationUnauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again, then return to enterprise admin.
enterpriseAdmin.elevationNetworkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
enterpriseAdmin.switchAdminAccountFailed: Could not switch accounts. Please try again.
enterpriseAdmin.switchAdminAccountOpened: Enterprise login page opened. Sign in with an admin account.

authProviders.title: Auth & Login
authProviders.enterprisePageDesc: Org admins configure enterprise SSO and outbound mail. By default, only one SSO provider should be active; the login page shows enabled providers.
authProviders.ssoPolicyHint: Enterprise SSO (LDAP, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom) should usually have only one provider enabled to avoid conflicting org structures. SMTP mail settings are independent.
authProviders.ssoConflictDesc: Another enterprise login method is already enabled. Running multiple SSO providers may create duplicate org structures and identity bindings. Continue anyway?
authProviders.saveWithoutTestHint: Save does not require a successful test. Fill in the fields and click Save—you can change settings or test anytime later.
authProviders.providerComingSoonBody: This sign-in method will be configured here in a future release. It can run alongside LDAP, Feishu, and others.
authProviders.oauthLoginPending: After saving, the login page can show this provider. OAuth callback flows are still being wired—confirm redirect URLs in the vendor console before enabling.
authProviders.dingtalkHint: DingTalk Open Platform app for enterprise scan / SSO (can run with LDAP and Feishu).
authProviders.wecomHint: WeCom self-built app for member scan login (can run with LDAP and Feishu).
authProviders.smtpHint: For admin password-reset email and notifications. Saved config overrides ONE_SMTP_* env vars when enabled.
authProviders.smtpTestToHint: Leave empty to send the test message to the From address
authProviders.smtpTestSuccess: SMTP test succeeded (connection verified and test message sent)
authProviders.desc: Configure WebUI sign-in methods: Local / LDAP / Feishu. External sign-in requires admin binding.
authProviders.ldapHint: LDAP/AD sign-in. Choose transport (LDAP or LDAPS), host, and port, then configure the service bind account and Base DN.
authProviders.ldapPlainModeHelp: Unencrypted LDAP for trusted intranets only. Enter the directory host and port (usually 389). No certificate setup.
authProviders.ldapTlsModeHelp: LDAPS uses TLS from the first byte. Use port 636 typically. If you see "unable to get local issuer certificate", enable skip verification below or import your enterprise root CA.
authProviders.ldapBindSectionHint: Base DN is only the search root. Directory queries require a service bind first—fill Bind DN (recommended) or bind account + password; otherwise tests and LDAP user search will fail.
authProviders.ldapBindPasswordHint: Provide Bind DN or bind account (at least one) plus password. Base DN alone cannot authenticate AD searches.
authProviders.errorElevationRequired: Complete enterprise secondary verification (banner at top) before saving.
authProviders.errorPermissionOutdated: Permission check failed (often an outdated app build). Restart the app/WebUI and try again; org admins should be allowed to save.
authProviders.errorTlsCertificate: Cannot verify the LDAPS server certificate (common with internal/self-signed CAs). Enable "Skip TLS certificate verification (intranet only)", save, and retry.
authProviders.ldapTlsSkipVerifyHint: Fixes "unable to get local issuer certificate". Do not use on public networks.
authProviders.feishuHint: Feishu OAuth + QR sign-in. Ensure redirectUri is whitelisted in Feishu console.
authProviders.feishuBindingHint: After saving Feishu config, bind a local user to union_id / open_id in User Management, or the OAuth callback will be rejected.
authProviders.feishuRedirectHint: Use a callback URL reachable from Feishu. Do not use localhost; prefer a LAN IP or real domain.
authProviders.ldapBindPasswordMaskedPlaceholder: Password saved; leave blank to keep it, or type a new password to replace

healthCheckHintGeneric: Please verify API Key, baseUrl, request protocol/mode, and gateway routing.
agentToolkit.title: Agent Toolkit
agentToolkit.description: Bundled CodeGraph, Superpowers skills, find-skills, and agent-browser — enabled for all agents without extra setup.
agentToolkit.enabledHint: Master switch for bundled skills, CodeGraph MCP, and browser automation helpers.
agentToolkit.codegraphEnabledHint: Expose local code intelligence via the built-in codegraph MCP server.
agentToolkit.codegraphAutoIndexHint: Run codegraph init --index when you open a project folder as the workspace.
agentToolkit.agentBrowserAutoInstallHint: Download Chrome for Testing on first launch (one-time, may take a few minutes).
agentToolkit.superpowersHooksEnabledHint: Inject using-superpowers guidance on the first message (SessionStart hook equivalent).
agentToolkit.injectSkillsForAllAgentsHin: Include builtin skills index on first message even for agents with native skill discovery.
